description: This file contains utility functions for formatting and retrieving cell values in a data grid, including handling HTML sanitization, number formatting, and value extraction based on column metadata.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Formats a cell value based on its formatter, handling undefined, null, HTML content, and other types.

methods.name: formatColumnValue
methods.description: Determines the appropriate formatter for a column and formats the value accordingly, including handling small numbers.

methods.name: valueFormatter
methods.description: Provides a string representation of a cell value for display, handling undefined, null, and special cases.

methods.name: valueGetter
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a cell based on column metadata and row data, with special handling for main columns.
